summary: The finished project satisfies the approved plan for a tiny dependency-free static quote board with local favorite persistence. Source inspection found the required browser app files, responsive layout hooks, search and favorites filtering, localStorage persistence, documentation, and improvement log. No blockers or major mismatches were identified.

ui_review.summary: Preview metadata and validation evidence indicate the static app is being served without console errors, and source inspection shows a coherent responsive UI with the core quote browsing, search, favorite save, and favorites-only flows implemented.

checks: Verified required app and documentation files are present.
Reviewed HTML structure for semantic app shell, filters, quote list, template, and script wiring.
Reviewed JavaScript for quote rendering, search filtering, favorites-only filtering, localStorage read/write, and event handling.
Reviewed CSS for responsive grid behavior, mobile breakpoints, stable card layout, and basic interaction states.
Reviewed README and improvement log against the approved validation and continuous improvement requirements.
Ran the lightweight syntax validation reported by the implementation evidence.
